constraints: option selects a standard printing option (an Integer constant from the Print Options theme) or a PDF option code (a Text string of the form "OptionType:OptionName"); which of value1/value2 are meaningful, and their expected types, depends entirely on which option was passed (e.g. Paper option returns width in value1 and height in value2; Orientation option uses value1 only; Destination option returns a destination code in value1 and a pathname in value2). See the SET PRINT OPTION command description for the full per-option value contract.
If the current value for the given option is not in the predefined list, value1 returns -1 and OK is set to 1; if an error occurs, value1 and OK are both set to 0.
Mainly supports PostScript printers; some options may be unavailable on other printer types (PCL, Ink, etc.).
_needsReview: The option-to-value1/value2 contract is a large per-constant table (Paper, Orientation, Scale, Destination, Double sided, Page range, Print preview, etc.) documented under SET PRINT OPTION. Modeling it precisely would need a discriminatedBy entry per option constant (or a shared enum in Layer 2); left as a prose constraint here rather than guessing an incomplete discriminatedBy mapping.
